desc: Implement a Fenwick Tree (BIT) that supports point updates and prefix sum queries, and also supports finding the smallest index with a given prefix sum (k-th available position) using binary lifting.
Read the input N and the array P.
Initialize the BIT with 1s at all positions from 1 to N, representing all positions as initially available.
Iterate from i = N down to 1: use the BIT to find the P_i-th available position, assign A[position] = i, and update the BIT at that position to 0 (marking it as occupied).
Print the resulting array A as space-separated values.
